$comment: Lake.Delta's support declaration (docs/lake/goal.md G1; docs/lake/verification/gap-review-2026-10.md §8). One entry per Delta table feature. status: supported | refused | planned. A supported feature needs a linked test that honours it; a refused one needs a test showing the refusal (the error users see). Writing to a table that lists a writer feature we don't support must be refused before anything is written: ignoring a writer feature corrupts the table for every other engine. Protocol facts are from the Delta protocol specification and are checked in this repository only once a tagged test exists (docs/lake/delta.md).

features.name: appendOnly
features.writerObligation: Refuse any commit that removes data (remove actions with dataChange=true) while delta.appendOnly=true

features.name: invariants
features.writerObligation: Evaluate column invariants (delta.invariants metadata) on every written row, or refuse to write

features.name: checkConstraints
features.writerObligation: Evaluate delta.constraints.* SQL expressions on every written row, or refuse to write (needs a SQL expression evaluator)

features.name: changeDataFeed
features.writerObligation: When delta.enableChangeDataFeed=true, write cdc files for updates and deletes (or refuse those operations)

features.name: generatedColumns
features.writerObligation: Compute or validate generation expressions for generated columns, or refuse to write

features.name: identityColumns
features.writerObligation: Assign identity values and advance the high-water mark in metadata, or refuse to write

features.name: columnMapping
features.writerObligation: Resolve by physical name (name mode) or field ID (id mode); write physical names and IDs; keep maxColumnId

features.name: deletionVectors
features.writerObligation: Apply DVs on read; on write, keep DVs consistent with tightBounds and numRecords; Roaring64 bytes shared with Iceberg v3 (to be verified against Delta's DV test files)

features.name: timestampNtz
features.writerObligation: Read and write timestamp without time zone

features.name: v2Checkpoint
features.writerObligation: Read V2 checkpoints with sidecars; write V2 checkpoints when the feature is present

features.name: vacuumProtocolCheck
features.writerObligation: Vacuum must check the protocol before deleting files

features.name: typeWidening
features.writerObligation: Read files written before a widening; record widenings in field metadata

features.name: variantType
features.writerObligation: Parquet variant encoding (shared with Iceberg v3 once Lake.Data has it)

features.name: rowTracking
features.writerObligation: Assign baseRowId and defaultRowCommitVersion; keep row IDs through rewrites (as Iceberg v3 lineage)

features.name: domainMetadata
features.writerObligation: Preserve domainMetadata actions; conflict-check them

features.name: clustering
features.writerObligation: Preserve the clustering domain metadata; writes need not cluster

features.name: inCommitTimestamp
features.writerObligation: Write commitInfo.inCommitTimestamp first in each commit, monotonically increasing; time travel by timestamp uses it

features.name: allowColumnDefaults
features.writerObligation: Fill CURRENT_DEFAULT values for columns omitted on insert, or refuse

features.name: checkpointProtection
features.writerObligation: Do not remove checkpoints or commits the feature protects during log cleanup

features.name: icebergCompatV1
features.writerObligation: UniForm: keep Iceberg metadata in step. Out of scope (VISION.md: no format conversion until each format stands alone)

features.name: icebergCompatV2
features.writerObligation: As icebergCompatV1
